# Command-line reference

Every command and option of `hxex`, from the program's own definitions (`hxex COMMAND --help` prints the same). [The project file and the commands](project-file.md) shows how they fit together.

Messages and progress go to the terminal's error stream, results and summaries to its output. Ctrl-C stops a run cleanly after the current step (a second Ctrl-C aborts at once). Exit status: 0 done, 1 an error (its message is printed), 2 a usage error, 130 stopped.

## Options of every command

Given before the command: `hxex -v run hxex.toml`.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--version` | print the version and exit |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | warnings and errors only |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | more messages |
| `--progress-every` `SECONDS` | seconds between progress lines (default 30) |

## hxex init

Write a project file with every default.

`hxex init [options]`

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--format` `{specexport,hxexpress,pooled,mzml,thermo}` | the input format (default specexport) |
| `--project` `PROJECT` | the project name |
| `-o`, `--output` `OUTPUT` | the file to write (default hxex.toml; '-' for stdout) |
| `--force` | replace an existing file (without it, init refuses to write over one) |

## hxex check

Check a project file and show what would be read.

`hxex check PROJECT [options]`

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `PROJECT` | the project file (TOML) |
| `--spectra` `PATH` | take the raw spectra stored in this bundle (or spectra file) instead of reading the input (as input.spectra) |

## hxex run

Run a project: read, pick, fit, bootstrap, write.

`hxex run PROJECT [options]`

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `PROJECT` | the project file (TOML) |
| `--bundle` `BUNDLE` | the results bundle (instead of output.bundle) |
| `--overwrite` | replace an existing bundle (and its tables and figures), carrying its review over |
| `--keep-previous` | move an existing bundle (with its tables and figures) to the next generation, NAME.N, before writing |
| `--device` `DEVICE` | cpu, cuda, cuda:1, ... (instead of run.fit.backend) |
| `--spectra` `PATH` | take the raw spectra stored in this bundle (or spectra file) instead of reading the input (as input.spectra) |
| `--threads` `N` | CPU threads (default: the project file's threads, else PyTorch's) |

## hxex resume

Add the bootstrap to a bundle that is waiting for it.

`hxex resume BUNDLE [options]`

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `BUNDLE` | a results bundle (a folder, or .zip) |
| `--device` `DEVICE` | cpu, cuda, cuda:1, ... (instead of the run's device) |
| `--threads` `N` | CPU threads (default: the project file's threads, else PyTorch's) |
| `--tables` `[DIR]` | also write the tables (default: beside the bundle) |
| `--figures` `[DIR]` | also write the figures (default: beside the bundle) |

## hxex report

Write tables and figures from a saved bundle.

`hxex report BUNDLE [options]`

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `BUNDLE` | a results bundle (a folder, or .zip) |
| `--threads` `N` | CPU threads (default: the project file's threads, else PyTorch's) |
| `--tables` `[DIR]` | write the tables (default: beside the bundle) |
| `--figures` `[DIR]` | write the figures (default: beside the bundle) |
| `--series` `{flagged,all}` | which series to draw (default: the run's plot setting, else flagged) |
| `--format` `{pdf,png,svg}` | figure file format |

## hxex analyse

The post-fitting analysis of a bundle: tables and figures.

`hxex analyse PROJECT|BUNDLE ... [options]`

Also spelt `hxex analyze`.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `PROJECT\|BUNDLE ...` | a project file (its [analysis] settings, and [analysis.runs] or output.bundle; a file with only [analysis] is enough), a bundle, or several bundles to compare as separate runs (NAME=BUNDLE, or BUNDLE named after its file; the tables get a run column) |
| `--bundle` `BUNDLE` | the bundle (instead of the project's output.bundle) |
| `--out` `OUT` | the output directory (default: [analysis] out, else the bundle's name + _analysis) |
| `--reference` `REFERENCE` | the reference sample (instead of [analysis] reference; RUN:sample when the sample is in several runs) |
| `--format` `{pdf,png,svg}` | figure file format |
| `--threads` `N` | CPU threads (default: the project file's threads, else PyTorch's) |

## hxex info

What a results bundle holds.

`hxex info BUNDLE [options]`

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `BUNDLE` | a results bundle (a folder, or .zip) |
| `--verify` | also check every file's checksum |
